purpose: Source-discovery metadata for review and future local retrieval. The runtime currently uses a small curated reference list; URLs do not prove that a source supports a specific hypothesis.

manufacturerEvidenceRequires: relevant manual section and page inspected
specific claim matched to inspected source
doNot: copy manual text or PDF without checking redistribution rights
infer fault causes from document titles or section headings
apply one model's guidance to all equipment
invent alarm meanings, setpoints, torque values, pressure limits, or parts
treat an OEM support portal or general troubleshooting article as proof that a particular cause applies to a specific machine
